item.tib: dbal mo las thig gi mchong chung
item.coloph: dmu' (dmu) tsha bdag gis gsang brag rgya bo'i g.yon zur/ rgya bo mched kyi g.yas zur/ sog po 'bros 'dra'i brag la sbas so/ yum sras lnga la bka'i gnyer gtad bcol/ dun tse'i lag tu ma shor bar/ skyes bu gcig gis rnyed par shog rnyed nas bstan pa spel bar shog u ya ag tham/ 'or bsgom gyis ('ol sgom gyi) gter ma'o// gtugs so/ dag go/
